title: transvfc: a transformable video feature compression framework for machines
core_idea: Propose TransVFC, a compress-then-transfer framework that compresses video features with a video-feature codec (using scheme-based inter-prediction to reduce temporal redundancy and perception-guided conditional coding to reduce spatial redundancy and align features with machine perception) and uses lightweight feature space transform (FST) modules to map reconstructed features into task-specific feature spaces, so new downstream tasks require only training a small FST module without retraining the upstream codec or task networks.
tldr: A framework for video feature compression and flexible transfer to multiple downstream machine-vision tasks via a codec that reduces temporal and spatial redundancy and lightweight FST modules that adapt compressed features to new tasks without retraining the main pipeline.
